Class DatabaseManager

java.lang.Object
DatabaseManager
public class DatabaseManager extends Object
Database Manager for Machamp POS System using SQLite. Handles database connections, table creation, and CRUD operations for drinks, ingredients, employees, customers, and order history.
Author:
Juan Elias

  • Constructor Details

    • DatabaseManager

      public DatabaseManager()
      Default constructor - initializes database connection and creates tables. Does not reset existing data.

    • DatabaseManager

      public DatabaseManager(boolean reset)
      Constructor with optional reset functionality. Initializes database connection, optionally drops and recreates tables, and loads sample data.
      Parameters:
      reset - if true, existing tables are dropped and recreated fresh each startup

  • Method Details

    • importOrderHistoryFromCSV

      public void importOrderHistoryFromCSV(String path) throws Exception
      Imports orders from a CSV file with headers: DateTime,Order ID,Customer ID,Menu Items,Total Price Menu Items column contains a Python dict-like string: {'Drink': (a,b,c), ...} which is normalized to a JSON-like string: {"Drink": [a,b,c], ...}
      Parameters:
      path - the file path to the CSV file
      Throws:
      Exception - if the file cannot be read or import fails

      public boolean updateEmployee(int id, String firstName, String lastName, String email, String role, Boolean active) throws SQLException

      firstName - the new first name, or null to keep current value

      role - the new role, or null to keep current value
